items.evidence: POST /api/sessions with existing teacher_id=daf6a573-5b28-44ce-bfab-6a0754c12932 returned 200 and body {id:"b4d13e4a-cbb4-4e55-8d24-ec7fb284ecf5",code:"BYQ5DP",name:"AO T4 R2 Active"}. Response omitted teacher_id, chapter_ids, status, max_participants, created_at, ended_at as required. Code path also returns only {id, code, name} at server/src/routes/sessions.ts:168.

GET /api/sessions with the same teacher headers returned 200 + Cache-Control:no-store. While AO T4 R2 Active was active it appeared before ended sessions and showed participant_count=1; after ending it moved into the ended block. curl also confirmed the no-store header on the list response.

GET /api/sessions/b4d13e4a-cbb4-4e55-8d24-ec7fb284ecf5 as the owner returned 200 with session metadata plus participants[{nickname:"3조 민지",progress_count:0}] before progress writes, matching the teacher detail contract.

GET /api/sessions/b4d13e4a-cbb4-4e55-8d24-ec7fb284ecf5/participants returned 200 + Cache-Control:no-store with {status:"active",participants:[...progress_count:1]} after the participant completed one read/quiz update, confirming the polling endpoint stays in sync with teacher detail.

POST /api/join for code BYQ5DP returned 200 + Cache-Control:no-store, set-cookie arch_pt=..., and body {session_id:"b4d13e4a-cbb4-4e55-8d24-ec7fb284ecf5",participant_id:"7bfcc88f-2a9b-443d-a408-0fd1d9235838",nickname:"3조 민지"}.
curl POST /api/join with code ZZZZZZ returned 404 and body {"error":"session_not_found"}. This matches JoinPage's invalid path handling.

A second fixture session (d25771ee-de06-4812-b504-70912be926b4 / XX4WY6) was ended first, then POST /api/join returned 410 {error:"session_closed"}. JoinPage exposes distinct closed and expired banners, with the expired copy added at client/src/pages/JoinPage.tsx:14-24.

PATCH /api/progress for the participant cookie succeeded twice with 200 {ok:true}: first with read_at=2026-04-28T20:55:00.000Z, then with quiz_score=67. Subsequent participant GET /api/sessions/:id returned viewer.progress.ch06_q03={read:true,quizScore:67} and teacher-side progress_count advanced from 0 to 1.

The participant cookie issued for session BYQ5DP was reused against the different ended session XX4WY6; GET /api/sessions/d25771ee-de06-4812-b504-70912be926b4 returned 401 {error:"unauthorized"}. This matches the intended expired-session client behavior, and LearnPage now maps 401 to /join?expired=1 at client/src/pages/LearnPage.tsx:217-224.

GET /api/sessions/b4d13e4a-cbb4-4e55-8d24-ec7fb284ecf5 with a different existing teacher_id=03faab0d-c37c-474d-8ee7-a869457d4c13 returned 403 {error:"forbidden"}, so owner-only protection remained intact.
POST /api/sessions/b4d13e4a-cbb4-4e55-8d24-ec7fb284ecf5/end returned 200 and the full ended row with status:"ended" plus ended_at:"2026-04-28T20:54:53.325+00:00".

After the active session was ended, PATCH /api/progress with the same participant cookie returned 410 {error:"session_closed"}. Direct Supabase query on architecture_progress still showed the pre-end row with updated_at="2026-04-28T20:54:52.928+00:00", proving the operating DB has the updated_at column applied and the closed-session guard prevented a post-close mutation. The resolver now performs a separate architecture_sessions status query at server/src/routes/progress.ts:33-55 instead of relying on an !inner relation.

JoinPage includes an explicit expired banner message '참여 시간이 만료되었습니다. 닉네임을 다시 입력해 참여해주세요.' ahead of invalid/closed handling at client/src/pages/JoinPage.tsx:14-24, covering the new expired UX copy path.

Session round-trip regression remained clean on ee0f057: create -> join -> teacher detail -> participant detail -> progress write -> participants poll -> end -> closed/expired errors all matched the PR6 contract, with no unexpected 500s observed in the server during the exercised paths.

summary: Round 2 T4 session flow passed on detached HEAD ee0f057. The previously flagged fixes were all present in behavior: POST /api/sessions now returns only {id,code,name}, participant progress resolution uses separate participant/session checks, architecture_progress.updated_at is populated in the live DB, LearnPage maps 401 to /join?expired=1, and JoinPage has a distinct expired banner.
